acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a contractor for siding repair in local areas like Daly City or San Bruno, look for one with a strong local reputation, proper licensing, and insurance. Ask for references and view examples of their past work. Ensure they provide a detailed, written estimate outlining all costs and the scope of work. Choosing a local contractor familiar with area-specific building codes and weather patterns is also beneficial.
